k: Air-coil, armature and stator winding across brushed, brushless and universal motors. Servo-driven wire placement, programmable tension, and multi-station configurations for higher throughput.

Dedicated BLDC stator preparation — horizontal and vertical slot insulation paper insertion, wedge insertion, and stator fusing. The equipment behind e-mobility, drone and cooling-fan motor programmes.

The complete armature route: slot insulation and wedge insertion, hook-type winding, commutator slot cutting and assembly, shaft embossing, welding and fusing, turning, balancing, varnish bake and final test.
Stator slot insulation paper insertion and varnish bake, for brushed and universal motor stators.
Standard machine modules linked into a running line — cooling-fan motor assembly and configurable winding cells. Capacity is added by adding modules, not by replacing the line.
Automatic bobbin winding for ignition coils and wound bobbins — multi-section winding, terminal handling and continuous production, standalone or linked into a bobbin line.
SCARA and six-axis integration for handling, loading and inter-station transfer — used where cycle time or part geometry rules out fixed automation.
Purpose-built automation where a catalogue machine does not fit: automatic feeding systems, turntable assembly cells and vibration-feed assembly equipment, designed around the part.
Sealing and testing process equipment built for semiconductor packaging — the same motion, vision and control platform applied outside motor production.
